verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents trait-based targeting (geography, plan, device, app version). It also documents segments, defined as groups of users matching trait rules, with flag overrides for all users in a segment, percentage rollouts within a segment, and identity-level overrides. Multivariate flags can be combined with segments for A/B/n variations. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that segments are reused across multiple flags, detail on rule operators and condition logic, explicit docs on serving a specific multivariate variant per segment, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
